core_problem_solved: To provide a general-purpose template engine for Java, allowing for a clean separation of presentation (the template for HTML, email, etc.) from the application logic and data model.
key_features: A powerful and comprehensive template language (FTL - FreeMarker Template Language)
Data model abstraction (works with POJOs, Maps, etc.)
era_and_niche: A mature and widely used template engine in the Java ecosystem, used for generating a wide variety of text outputs from web pages and emails to source code and configuration files.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **not obsolete** and is actively maintained. It is a primary competitor to other popular template engines. In the Spring Boot ecosystem, **Thymeleaf** is often the default choice for web views, but FreeMarker is a fully supported and popular alternative. The choice is typically based on project requirements and developer preference.
